reviewed_boundaries: Full curve consumption validation and risk raw-input/training-artifact chain replay precede matching or refusal; invalid evidence cannot be short-circuited as harmless mismatch.
Expected curve cohort/model/policy and fixed risk cohort/artifact are checked separately from seals. Both source closures remain explicit caller-supplied trusted identities.
Six original objects each require exact canonical hash and actual serial downstream read clocks after their original availability and by the original decision information cutoff.

Exact instrument/currency metadata/pip/official-M reference price and effective close clock are required. Original S5/M1 bar labels are preserved separately; no rounding, relabeling, or BA-to-M equivalence is inferred.

The selected target must be native to both original chains, with exact zero-delay target selection and original curve node admitted at issue; original target expiry, minimum remaining time and curve decision age are enforced.

Both fixed risk methods retain the unchanged full-horizon marginal nodes. Long/short labels follow explicitly supplied caller side context, with common endpoint/range/variation labels retained separately.
Attachment computation has its own actual completion clock after replay. Historical decision information cutoff is not claimed as this diagnostic computation time.
Output inputs are detached, exact Decimal comparisons use private precision, and validate_attachment rebuilds the complete result rather than trusting a resealed output.
scope_limits: Read-only source/test inspection only. No independent pytest rerun, broker call, runtime read/write, fitting, actual retained-chain diagnostic, or production integration was performed for this review.
Caller-supplied source identities and read receipts require external authentication; canonical hashes do not authenticate I/O or actual position identity.
Candidate/incumbent side is caller context, not verified direction admission or live position evidence.
Original full-horizon risk is not a remaining conditional distribution, stop rule, position size, joint probability, calibrated joint event, or executable-fill claim.
Actual recovered S5 target window 0..7 seconds cannot silently join an exact M1 target, and different reference/target events remain explicitly unavailable.
